methods.hc0: Native R car::linearHypothesis + sandwich::vcovHC(HC0); native Stata regress/test HC1 Wald converted to HC0 by N/df_r
methods.homoskedastic: Native R car::linearHypothesis(test=F) and Stata regress/test
methods.topology: Exact dyadic input algebra; integer polynomials and Sturm count/isolation. Native package point tests and local brackets do not certify global topology.

rows: All 120 rows per generated CSV, no filters or weights; distant.csv adds 12000*x to q2 y. All 1500 original M0 rows retained unchanged.

scope.hc0: One endogenous variable, 1-4 excluded instruments, <=12 auxiliary columns, unweighted independent observations, full-rank design and covariance nonsingular on R
scope.homoskedastic: One endogenous variable, <=12 auxiliary columns, positive residual df; unweighted iid normal homoskedastic errors for exact F reference
scope.unsupported: weights, clustered/HAC errors, multiple endogenous variables: unavailable; never substitute HC0

critical_value: Exact inversion of recorded scipy binary64 chi2/F ppf, not certification of the exact transcendental quantile or coverage assumptions
precision: Disjoint rational root isolators width <=max(1,abs(endpoint))*2^-44; displayed floats are approximations. All real roots, repeated roots, singularities, and both tails enumerated.

simulation.global_subset: first six fixed replicates; all 200 tested using native statsmodels HC0; no failures discarded
